newsitem.title: USA: Connie Lee says has capacity for two N.Y. agencies.
newsitem.headline: Connie Lee says has capacity for two N.Y. agencies.

text.p: Connie Lee Insurance Co said Tuesday it has limited secondary market insurance capacity for the following issues:
--New York State Med Care/Dorm Authority -- Mental Health Facilities with a 20-year minimum maturity.
--New York State Dorm Authority -- State University System with a 10-year minimum maturity.
Capacity is on a first-come, first-served basis in $1 million block minimum size, Connie Lee said.
For more information, call Larry Weiss at 202-728-3436 or 800-877-5333.
